application_scope: anonymous atmospheric reactive-transport proxy with a reduced one-box loss/source map
original_measurement_agencies: New York State Department of Conservation
target_clock: mean ozone 1300-1500 hours; next daily window
model: c_next=rho*c+b, 0<=rho<=1, b>=0; O3 -> unobserved sink plus constant external source
rate_set_status: training loss tolerance only; not a calibrated confidence set
positivity_domain: nonnegative concentration; fitted map preserves it
conservation: open measured ozone box; unobserved sink and source make observed species mass nonconserved
measurement_method: archived agency ozone summary; instrument and detection limit not retained by benchmark
time_zone: historical local sampling window; UTC offset not provided in source
limits: Benchmark tests a deliberately reduced open-box model; it does not validate named atmospheric reaction rates.
No spatial transport measurement is present; two-cell transport toy remains synthetic.
Unknown forcing, seasonal changes and missing observations can dominate mismatch.
Meteorological channels have different sites/windows and are not conflated with simultaneous species observations.
EPA 2024 bulk endpoints timed out; fallback was frozen before fitting.
